subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart & rate limits
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditi Mehra <aditi@finpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart & rate limits

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for your time this afternoon. Great to meet you and Aditi and to walk through how FinPay might use Redwood for fraud detection and conversational routing. Quick recap and next steps to get you into a Hosted API eval: 

1) Quickstart (3–15 min)
   - Create an org and API key: https://console.redwood.ai (Invite link attached in the quickstart PDF).
   - Endpoints you’ll likely use: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions (streaming supported), POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings for batch/online embeddings, and POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate for single-shot generation.
   - Example curl (see attached quickstart PDF for code snippets):
     curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'

2) Rate limits / throughput notes
   - Default Hosted API per-key request concurrency: ~60 requests/sec (can burst higher briefly).
   - Org-level token throughput: typical soft limit ~250k tokens/min; for sustained high-volume embedding ingestion we recommend a Dedicated capacity or a temporary limit increase for the POC.
   - Streaming: supported on chat/completions with chunked transfer; helpful for low-latency UX.

3) Data & retention
   - Hosted API: request/response logs retained 30 days by default for debugging and quality monitoring. Enterprise customers can opt for extended retention or a Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) if logs must remain in-customer control.

4) Proposed next steps
   - Let us know whether you want to start with Hosted API for the eval, or if you expect to need Dedicated capacity from day 1 (high sustained throughput, strict latency SLOs, or strict network isolation).
   - If Hosted is fine for the eval, we can provision a temporary rate limit bump for your POC.
   - I’ve attached a short quickstart PDF and the demo recording link.

Could you confirm:
 - Expected daily token volume for the eval (rough ballpark is fine).
 - Target 99th percentile latency SLO for chat/completions.
 - Any data residency or retention requirements that would push you to Private deployment early.

I’ll loop in Ben (AE) and Dev (SE) to help scope the POC based on your answers. Available times next week: Tue/Wed 9–11am PT or Thu 1–4pm PT — which works best for a short POC kickoff?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpay.com>

Cc: Aditi Mehra <aditi@finpay.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart & rate limits

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few quick answers and questions from our side: 

- For the POC we’re looking at an ingestion workload of roughly 5–10M tokens/day for embeddings (backfill) and ~200k conversational tokens/day once we integrate chat for routing.
- Latency SLO: for chat routing we’re aiming for 95th <150ms and 99th <350ms for typical 256–512 token exchanges.
- Data residency: US-only is fine for now. We do have PCI-adjacent requirements and would prefer logs not be retained longer than 90 days unless necessary.

Questions:
1) Can you confirm the exact token throughput limits for embeddings (bulk ingestion)? We may need temporary higher throughput for the backfill.
2) For streaming responses — does the Hosted API support server-side streaming (chunked) for chat/completions? Any extra latency added by that path?
3) What’s the procurement path / paperwork if we want a temporary limit bump or an SLA for the POC?

We’re happy to start on Hosted API for the eval if we can get a short-term token throughput increase for the backfill. Tue 10am PT next week works for a kickoff.

—Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Platform
FinPay
samir.khan@finpay.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation - quickstart & rate limits

Hi Samir — looping in Dev (SE) to scope the technical side. Short answers and a proposed plan: 

- Embedding ingestion: Hosted API can handle high-throughput ingestion, but sustained backfill volumes (multi-M tokens/hr) are a better fit for Dedicated or a staged approach where we temporarily raise your Hosted token quota for the POC. For 5–10M tokens/day we can provision a temporary increase to ~500k tokens/min for the backfill window.
- Streaming: yes, server-side chunked streaming is supported on /v1/chat/completions. The streaming path is optimized and usually adds negligible overhead vs non-streamed responses — most customers see comparable 95th/99th percentiles.
- Procurement for temporary limits: we can do a short POC agreement (standard POC addendum) to enable quota increases. I’ll attach our POC checklist and draft addendum. For longer-term production with your latency SLOs, Dedicated capacity reduces jitter and provides guaranteed throughput/SLA.

Proposed POC (what we’ve done for similar fintech customers):
 - 2-week POC: 1 week for embedding backfill (we’ll help with bulk ingestion and can enable a higher temporary quota), 1 week for integration/latency testing with streaming chat.
 - Redwood provides: temporary token throughput bump, SE support during backfill, a lightweight performance dashboard for tokens and latency.
 - Customer provides: sample dataset for embeddings, test traffic mix, primary SRE contact.

Marissa — can you confirm HubSpot deal FP-2026-045? Samir — I’ll send a short POC addendum draft; if that looks good we can get the quota changes in place before Tue 10am PT.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
